# ADR-3202: AWS iam: Resource star on sensitive IAM policy for role 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Resource=* widens blast radius.

## Decision

IAM policies MUST NOT use a Resource star on sensitive IAM policy for role 2 (AWS-iam-2).

## Consequences

Resources are ARNs scoped to the workload.
